_note: Community ESTIMATEs (public RHA-equivalent guesses, not official data) and DESIGN values (no estimate found, chosen for play).
One mm RHA-equivalent per box face, as protection against a hit square to that face; obliquity to the face adds 1/cos.
Every value says which it is in 'sources'. No War Thunder game data is used.

sources.source: commander's interview: combined protection more than 1000 mm RHA

sources.value: layout 'tank' (crew, ammunition, fuel, engine, transmission positions)
sources.source: generic module template scaled to the vehicle's boxes, not this vehicle's real internal layout

sources.value: front ERA: +225 mm vs KE, +600 mm vs CE (taken out of the front estimates, so intact the total is unchanged)
sources.source: ZTZ-99A (FY-4: no public figure found, assumed Kontakt-5 class): Kontakt-5 rated 200-250 mm vs APFSDS (middle used) and 600 mm vs HEAT

sources.value: hull side / turret roof ERA: -52 % HEAT penetration, no KE effect, 0.13 m tile
sources.source: Kontakt-1-type bricks assumed there (placement is DESIGN): maker's claim 52 % for tank HEAT rounds (86 % Konkurs ATGM, 92 % RPG), no effect on KE; 252x130 mm panels (half the long side as tile radius)
